name: Stellar Dilemma
source:
In the depths of space, you're an Android who discovers an unsettling truth during a space mission. What will you do to make a final decision that could change everything?

[From [url=https://mxrandom1401.itch.io/stellar-dilemma]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是個在太空深處執行任務的仿生人，途中發現了一個令人不安的真相。你會怎麼做？你最終的決定或許能改變一切。

（來源：[url=https://mxrandom1401.itch.io/stellar-dilemma]itch.io[/url]）
